written.title: GTA 6 preload date and times confirmed
written.description: What Game Informer, GamesRadar+, IGN, Kotaku, Polygon, Pure Xbox and Push Square reported: "GTA 6 preload date and times confirmed", in their own words.
written.body:
This page collects what named outlets published about GTA 6 preload date and Leonida, in their own words. This site wrote none of the sentences in quotation marks below. Each one links to the report it was taken from.

## Game Informer, 3 November 2026

[You Can Preload Grand Theft Auto VI On PS5 and Xbox Next Week, And You'll Want To Because It's Massive](https://gameinformer.com/2026/11/03/you-can-preload-grand-theft-auto-vi-on-ps5-and-xbox-next-week-and-youll-want-to-because)

The outlet's own summary:

> Make some space on your harddrive now. - Game Informer

> Elsewhere in today's GTA VI news, Rockstar has revealed that on November 19, it will add an official printable GTA VI cover art poster and a map of Leonida as a free digital download to the game's official site.

## GamesRadar+, 3 November 2026

[GTA 6 preload date and times confirmed](https://www.gamesradar.com/games/grand-theft-auto/gta-6-preload-date-times/)

The outlet's own summary:

> You can start preloading GTA 6 from November 10, and these are the details you need to know

> Every Friday GamesRadar+ Your weekly update on everything you could ever want to know about the games you already love, games we know you're going to love in the near future, and tales from the communities that surround them.

> If you want to get yourself prepared for launch day, then these are the preload times for GTA 6.

> Games Action Games Grand Theft Auto GTA 6 GTA 6 preload date and times confirmed Guides By Iain Wilson Published 3 November 2026 You can start preloading GTA 6 from November 10, and these are the details you need to know When you purchase through links on our site, we may earn an affiliate commission.

## GamesRadar+, 3 November 2026

[The Grand Theft Auto bonus that used to be free with every physical game is now a separate $1 purchase for GTA 6](https://www.gamesradar.com/games/grand-theft-auto/the-grand-theft-auto-bonus-that-used-to-be-free-with-every-physical-game-is-now-a-separate-usd1-purchase-for-gta-6/)

The outlet's own summary:

> You won't be getting your Leonida map in the box here

> "On November 19 we will be adding an official printable Grand Theft Auto VI cover art poster and map of Leonida as a free digital download to the official site," Rockstar says in an announcement also offering GTA 6 pre-load details .

## IGN, 3 November 2026

[GTA 6 Preload, Global Release Times and Install Size Confirmed, Rockstar Announces Physical Cover Art Poster and Map of Leonida](https://www.ign.com/articles/gta-6-preload-times-and-install-size-confirmed-rockstar-announces-physical-cover-art-poster-and-map-of-leonida)

The outlet's own summary:

> Rockstar Games has confirmed the GTA 6 preload and global release times, as well as the install size of the game.

> Back To Top Home › News › GTA 6 GTA 6 Preload, Global Release Times and Install Size Confirmed, Rockstar Announces Physical Cover Art Poster and Map of Leonida Midnight club.

> Elsewhere, Rockstar said that on November 19, the day GTA 6 comes out, it will add an official printable GTA 6 cover art poster and map of Leonida as a free digital download to the official site.

## IGN, 3 November 2026

[Xbox Announces Sweepstakes for an Alligator-Shaped Series X That You Can Win Before GTA 6 Launches](https://www.ign.com/articles/xbox-made-an-alligator-shaped-series-x-and-you-can-win-it-before-gta-6-launches)

The outlet's own summary:

> GTA 6 is mere weeks away from launch, and to celebrate, Xbox is bringing the wildlife of Leonida to players’ living rooms with a one-of-a-kind console.

> Back To Top Home › News › GTA 6 Xbox Made an Alligator-Shaped Series X, and You Can Win It Before GTA 6 Launches In true Leonida fashion.

> By Virginia Glaze Updated : Nov 3, 2026 7:20pm UTC Add IGN on Google 1 16 GTA 6 is mere weeks away from launch, and to celebrate, Xbox is bringing the wildlife of Leonida to players’ living rooms with a one-of-a-kind console.

> GTA 6 Launch Trailer Screenshots View 34 Images While Xbox didn’t directly mention GTA 6 in its posts about this unique contest, it’s hard not to see why it was made; the game takes place in a fictional version of Florida, which, as most folks will know, is home to all sorts of critters, including alligators.

## Kotaku, 3 November 2026

[GTA 6 Pre-Load Times, Install Size, And Global Release Schedule](https://kotaku.com/gta-6-pre-load-times-install-size-and-global-release-times-confirmed-2000752787)

The outlet's own summary:

> Here's how to make sure you're ready for the big day

> In addition to taking some time depending on the speed of your internet, you’ll want to make sure you have your library cleared of any non-essential games.

## Polygon, 3 November 2026

[For GTA 6, Xbox Put an Xbox Series X in an Alligator](https://www.polygon.com/xbox-alligator-console-giveaway-november-2026/)

The outlet's own summary:

> Xbox has unveiled the Series X-BITE, a working Xbox Series X swallowed by a custom alligator. Here's how to enter the giveaway.

> Related The Elder Scroll 6: Sentinel's name quietly teases a juicy Skyrim sequel A closer look at how TES6 might connect to Skyrim and The Elder Scrolls Online Posts 2 Google is changing how it surfaces content.

> No actual alligators were used or harmed in its creation.

## Pure Xbox, 3 November 2026

[GTA 6 Download Size & Preload Times Officially Revealed For Xbox Series X|S](https://www.purexbox.com/news/2026/11/gta-6-download-size-and-preload-times-officially-revealed-for-xbox-series-xs)

The outlet's own summary:

> Here we go!

> Rockstar says that this may change "depending on your device", but you'll want to make sure you have at least 212GB of spare storage just in case.

> 6 News Xbox Exec Issues Statement In Response To Review Controversy 7 News Xbox Suddenly Has Two Vice City Games Releasing In Mid-November 8 News 'We Did This To Support The BDS Boycott' - Two Xbox Games Delisted As Ce...

## Push Square, 3 November 2026

[GTA 6 PS5 File Size Confirmed to Be 212GB, Physical Map Available But Not in Boxed Copies](https://www.pushsquare.com/news/2026/11/gta-6-ps5-file-size-confirmed-to-be-212gb-physical-map-available-but-not-in-boxed-copies)

The outlet's own summary:

> Preload brought forward two days

> We will see 1 12 McBurn 6 hours ago No matter what they do, people will complain anyway so why put more effort into it xD 2 13 GirlVersusGame 6 hours ago That's if you want a real physical version of it.

> 10 News Final Fantasy Resonance Producer Had to Fight Square Enix Execs Who Want...

> Alternatively, there'll be a digital download of the GTA 6 boxart and the Leonida map, which I suppose you could just print out yourself.

> All the GTA 6 release info you need "On November 19 we will be adding an official printable Grand Theft Auto VI cover art poster and map of Leonida as a free digital download to the official site," Rockstar revealed.

> Author Profile Reply Comments 46 1 Can-You-Believe-Sith 6 hours ago "On November 19 we will be adding an official printable Grand Theft Auto VI cover art poster and map of Leonida as a free digital download to the official site," Rockstar revealed.

Every report above is on the site's fixed source list. A report is not a confirmation: the mark on each linked entry says who said it.
